verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for AI coding assistants, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented region or residency selection for Aider. Local-model support via Ollama (aider-docs-35) controls which model processes prompts, not a residency setting, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
